newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk Southern pleased deal schedule set.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk Southern pleased deal schedule set.

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp said it is pleased the U.S. has set a schedule that will allow for the completion of its proposed partial purchase of Conrail Inc.

"We're glad to have a schedule set and we're looking forward to getting on with it. Now we have a definite schedule with which to proceed," said Norfolk Southern spokesman Frank Brown. The U.S. Surface Transportation Board earlier announced a 350-day review period of the proposed $10.3 billion transaction. CSX and Norfolk Southern had asked the STB to review the transaction in 255 days.
